laws.rule: The legal age for buying and drinking alcohol in Abu Dhabi is 21. Drinking or being drunk in a public place is illegal anywhere in the UAE.

sources.title: United Arab Emirates travel advice: safety and security
sources.authority: UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office
sources.supports: legal drinking age 21 in Abu Dhabi, Dubai and the Northern Emirates except Sharjah; drinking or being drunk in public illegal anywhere in the UAE (read directly)
